In the background, a white mesh crib is visible under soft indoor lighting. (2) The girl uses both of her small hands to pat the top of the red book firmly as if interacting with it. The adult's finger points to the text on the book cover while the girl maintains an attentive facial expression. The girl leans her head down closely, placing her forehead near the book's surface. Her pigtails hang down as she appears to be listening or whispering to the book. The adult's hand remains in the frame, steadying the book on the bed. (4) The girl looks up at the camera with her mouth slightly open in a curious expression before leaning back down to the book. Variety-show style text overlays appear at the bottom of the screen, tracking the dialogue and emotional context. (5) The girl continues her interaction, and the book's left page now shows a yellow happy face instead of the red angry one. She sits up straight and smiles broadly, showing her small teeth, and then leans down to give the yellow illustration a kiss. (7) The girl points at the happy face and then interacts with her own clothing while talking to the adult off-camera. She looks directly into the lens with focused eyes as the conversation about bedtime and drinking milk concludes. (8) A pink final graphic screen appears, featuring a cartoon version of the girl and the text logo "POPO'S DAILY LIFE."
